metadata.description: Layered meta-framework combining ponytail (behavioral nudge), superpowers (process engine), and mattpocock/skills (composable toolbox) by altitude. See ADR 0001.
metadata.note: Per-layer skills arrays are populated as each layer is built (build order in CONTEXT-MAP.md). strict:false because skill dirs do not exist yet.

plugins.name: l0-constitution
plugins.description: Always-on minimal-code behavioral nudge. The only resident layer; governs solution size. Auto-fires (mode-filtered).

plugins.name: l1-alignment
plugins.description: Pin intent and vocabulary before building: grilling, domain modeling, CONTEXT.md glossary, and the complexity router.

plugins.name: l2-planning
plugins.description: Spec to plan to issues. User-invoked: to-issues (lightweight default) and writing-plans (heavyweight opt-in).

plugins.name: l3-execution
plugins.description: Subagent dispatch, merged TDD (dialed rigor), and worktree isolation. User-invoked.

plugins.name: l4-review
plugins.description: Three-lens review (correctness, over-engineering, security), merged debugging, and the verification evidence gate. Discipline skills auto-fire.

plugins.name: l5-meta
plugins.description: Skill authoring + quantitative eval loop + lessons.md self-improvement. Borrows skill-creator's run_loop.
